extraction.Name: Lucy Kincaid
extraction.Occupation/Income: I farm some and raise cattle, raise good garden
extraction.NOTES: Degree of blood: one half; married; attended school at St. Francis Mission for nine years; does not use intoxicants; in good physical condition; land described as south half of North-East quarter and North half of South-East quarter, Section 28, Township 99 N, Range 74 West, 5th P.M., valued at $6400.00; cultivates ten acres, balance pasture and hay land; has 10 head of horses, four milk cows, six hogs, 30 chickens; owes nobody and has no debts; no individual Indian money on credit; land not leased; has no other land; has managed her own business for 17 years without assistance of husband; wants patent in fee to obtain credit and purchase more stock; dependents listed: Johnio Kincaid, male, 5 months old; family allotments include Frankie Kincaid, male, 16 yrs, son, 160 acres; Effie Kincaid, female, 14, daughter, 160 acres; Hilda, female, 13, daughter; Clifford, male, 11, son; Rosa, female; Olie; Helen; Corine; application signed August 18, 1917; allotment located in Mellette Co. and Todd Co.; application covers all of allotment
